column4: Setup imports every valid ICO into the hashed cache and writes manifest and settings

Classic menu: one primary Folder Icons entry listing Reset, Repair and Uninstall first, then Choose Folder Icon with a reserved allotment of the first 12 icons; remaining icons in top-level alphabetical-range overflow entries of at most 16 icons; exact HKCU ownership, obsolete overflow entries pruned on rescan and removed by Uninstall, unrelated and lookalike keys untouched
Apply writes only icon fields, preserves unrelated desktop.ini content and recovers on failure
Reset removes icon fields, reclaims generated resources and returns fresh-process Shell resolution to default
Batch Apply/Reset keeps order and occurrences and reports one aggregate result
Selection broker registration-derived initialization and native ABI on x64 and x86
Repair validates installed resources offline and never reports false success
Ordinary Uninstall removes runtime and registration and preserves cache and applied resources
Public distribution ships exactly the ten colour ICOs and never a personal ICO
Installed x64 COM Apply/Reset dispatch on fresh fixtures (opt-in)
MANUAL Explorer: every chooser icon reachable and utilities accessible at the current icon count
MANUAL Explorer: Reset to Default renders the default icon in a fresh view and in a warm open view
MANUAL Explorer: Repair from the menu with one and with several folders selected
MANUAL Explorer: Uninstall prompts with several folders selected (observe only; cancel)
Repository contract: required files, root layout, script parsing, every ICO, docs, security scan, whitespace (scripts\verify.ps1)

Native verification infrastructure: harness built once per input set and reused, never a stale or tampered build; no false PASS from nonzero exits, crashes, denied or missing launches; NOT RUN, BLOCKED and FAIL kept distinct; every entrypoint withholds native launches unless explicitly authorized

Gate output housekeeping removes only unretained generated run evidence inside the ignored outputs folder; refuses links, unexpected roots and unsafe names; keeps RETAIN.md folders, possibly active runs and loose files

Shell-built static menu (SHCreateDefaultContextMenu on isolated keys written by Register-PfiContextMenu): every accepted icon exposed exactly once, Reset/Repair/Uninstall first and always present, every top-level tree within the measured static-menu entry budget, at 0/1/12/13/16/21/28/29/45/120 icons including expansion and shrinkage
